_comment: Declarative manifest for the revisar-actualizaciones skill. Each entry is one upstream artifact we pin. To track a new chart/image, add a component here -- the engine (scripts/check_versions.py) needs no changes. See reference.md for the field spec and the version-scheme gotchas.

components.title: Hermes Agent (app image)
components.version_scheme: SemVer vX.Y.Z since v0.21.6 (2026-10-08); CalVer vYYYY.M.D before (v2026.9.24 == v0.21.5). Ordered by publish date (latest.order) because the two schemes do not compare numerically.
components.notes: Chart pins appVersion to a release tag (= the Docker Hub tag, with the leading v) AND values.yaml pins the matching image.digest by default. With --digests the engine verifies the pinned digest matches appVersion and flags drift. On a bump, update BOTH appVersion (Chart.yaml) and image.digest (values.yaml) together.

components.title: OpenClaw (app image)
components.version_scheme: calver YYYY.M.D (image tags have NO leading v; GitHub release tags DO)
components.notes: Consumed by the operator via spec.image. Usually a low-risk bump for the chart (same CRD/operator). HOLD at 2026.8.x: 2026.9.x crash-loops (EPERM fchmod on the root-owned PVC root) until an openclaw-operator release > 0.40.0 ships the init-data-owner fix (#608) -- expect OUT here until then; bump app + operator together.

components.title: OpenClaw operator (Helm subchart)
components.version_scheme: semver (chart version, independent of the operator appVersion)
components.notes: Authoritative 'latest' = newest chart tag in the OCI registry (what `helm dependency update` pulls). Watch for a possible move to ghcr.io/openclaw-rocks/charts and update repo here if upstream migrates. After a bump run `helm dependency update charts/openclaw-instance` to refresh Chart.lock, and re-vendor crd-schema/ if the CRD changed.
